newsitem.title: POLAND: Travel agency offers air tours of Polish floods.
newsitem.headline: Travel agency offers air tours of Polish floods.

text.p: A Warsaw travel agency is offering special air tours over areas of Poland ravaged by the worst flood disaster in centuries, Gazeta Wyborcza newspaper reported on Friday.
"You can see the floods for yourself from the air -- not just on television," the top-selling daily quoted the unnamed agency's publicity as saying.
Prices range from a single passenger aircraft at 550 zlotys ($160) an hour up to $1,750 for an 18-seat plane which can pick up passengers as far away as Madrid.
